description: This source file defines an extension method for the Entity Framework Core DbSet<Articles> class, providing a way to retrieve articles with related data eagerly loaded.

classes.name: ArticleExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing an extension method for IQueryable of Article objects to include related entities and configure query behavior.

methods.name: GetAllData
methods.description: An extension method that retrieves all data for articles, including author, favorites, and tags, without tracking for read-only operations.
